design.input: Mandatory --consumer --tarball --output; existing independent consumer installed by bsolid-dist-pack. No install/manifests/workspace aliases/source imports.
design.archiveProof: Parse npm ustar/PAX archive, SHA-256 fingerprint, compare every installed file byte-for-byte, reject workspace/outside-consumer links.
design.compilation: Strict independent consumer types, production/development server and hydratable client compilation with stock RC13 and no shared harness.
design.ssr: Fresh bounded RTK Node process with worker/node and matching development condition; real package external server imports; no browser globals; concurrent namespace/request and incremental stream assertions.
design.browser: Explicit --phase browser only after stable archive; nonce CSP HTTP HTML executes emitted scripts; original hosts recorded before client import; all warnings/errors retained and fail.
design.state: Editable input/conditional/version use signals. Async request uses a shared async memo consumed by keyed For under Loading/Errored. No effect-relayed state or speculative memo boundaries.
design.completion: All required rows retained including blockers. Exit 0 only all rows both modes, 1 failure, 2 incomplete. No authored-fixture success claim.
